room.ferry_landing.title: Ferry Landing
room.ferry_landing.description: Reeds crowd a slick wooden landing. A mooring post leans into the current.
room.boathouse.title: Boathouse
room.boathouse.description: Oars and nets hang from the rafters above Bram's ferry.
room.well_lane.title: Well Lane
room.well_lane.description: Worn steps lead to the village well. A bucket hangs from its chain.
detail.mooring_post: Rope has worn a groove into the post. Someone has carved a fox into it.
detail.notice: A notice nailed to the post: no ferry after dark.
detail.tide_marks: Dark lines on the pilings show how high the river climbs.
detail.well: Mossy stones ring a deep shaft. Cold air rises from below.
detail.bucket: A wooden bucket on a rusted chain, still damp from the last draw.
detail.steps: The steps are worn hollow by a century of feet.
